title: Demo Builder AppBuilderComponents Catalog Schema
description: Schema for the declarative catalog of pre-built appBuilderComponents (meshes and integrations)

appBuilderComponents.description: Array of appBuilderComponent catalog entries (the three seeded meshes, plus integrations over time)

compatibleBackends.description: Backend ids this appBuilderComponent fits (omitted = any backend)

compatibleFrontends.description: Frontend ids this appBuilderComponent fits (omitted = any frontend)

requiredApis.description: Adobe API sdkCodes/names to subscribe on the workspace (e.g. GraphQLServiceSDK)

providesEnvVars.description: Env-var names this appBuilderComponent provides to consumers (e.g. MESH_ENDPOINT)

envSchema.description: The appBuilderComponent's own env-var schema (inputs it needs)

nativeForPackages.description: Demo package IDs this appBuilderComponent is native to (auto-included + locked, like a package-native block library). Mirrors block-libraries' nativeForPackages.

onlyForPackages.description: If set, this appBuilderComponent is available ONLY for these demo package IDs. Mirrors block-libraries' onlyForPackages.

layout.description: App Builder app layout. Omitted = standalone (app.config.yaml declares application.runtimeManifest.packages at the root). 'extension' = the config declares extensions: (e.g. commerce/extensibility/1) with the runtime manifest in an ext.config.yaml — the App Management generation's shape; the deploy path branches on this and skips the ow-package rewrite.

lifecycle.description: What happens after aio app deploy. Omitted = deploy-only (deployed = done). 'app-management' = the app must also be installed/associated with a Commerce instance via its own generated App Management API before events flow.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js MAJOR version this app's install/build/deploy must run under (e.g. "24"). The add door ensures it via fnm before installing (measured 2026-08-27: the starter kit is engine-strict node ^24 and npm refuses to install under anything older). Omitted = the executor's default node.

blank.description: A blank/starter app (the Build-custom default), NOT a finished pre-built integration. Excluded from the pre-built gallery.

seed.description: SEED scaffolding a custom app starts from (e.g. the Commerce integration starter kit), NOT a finished pre-built integration. Excluded from the pre-built gallery; offered beside 'Blank' on the Build-custom naming stage.

type.description: secret → masked + SecretStorage; text → Configure UI → .env

label.description: Human-readable label for the collection UI

derivedFrom.description: Derived from another known value (e.g. connect-commerce backend config)

providedBy.description: Provided by another appBuilderComponent that declares it in providesEnvVars
